sys.architectural_pattern: Workspace of independently versioned packages published to GitHub Packages

sprint.goal: Repo kit + docs + published @gokulsaraswat/ui v0.1 (tokens + footer), installable from another repo.
done: Step 1: repo kit (CLAUDE.md, README, ARCHITECTURE, CONTRACTS, LICENSE all-rights-reserved, SECURITY, .gitignore, .env.example, PR template), npm workspace root, Changesets init; scope renamed @gokul -> @gokulsaraswat (GitHub Packages scope must equal owner).

Step 2: packages/ui with tokens.css (bestportofolio colors/radius, Tailwind 4.3.3 type/shadows, Progress motion; durations = range midpoints) + tailwind.css mapping; 4 node:test checks; root build/lint/test scripts; .github/workflows/ci.yml; graphify-out generated; changeset (ui minor). Verified: npm test 4/4, Tailwind 4.3.3 compile in scratch dir. graphify hook install NOT run (blocked; owner runs it).

todo_next.item: React Footer (Privacy, Terms, Cookie Policy, Data Deletion Request, Accessibility Statement, Sitemap, FAQ, About, Contact) + legal/SEO page components with marked placeholder text. Add eslint + tsc (lint/build) with the first React code.

Verify install from a scratch consumer with .npmrc (@gokulsaraswat:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com) + read:packages token.
